blocks.text: be, been, being — qaysi biri kerak?

Majhul nisbatning asosi o'zgarmaydi: **be + V3** (→ 42-dars). Bu darsda **be** ning boshqa uch shakli o'rganiladi: **be**, **been** va **being**. Qaysi biri tanlanishi gapdagi **oldingi so'zga** bog'liq: modal fe'l yoki **to** dan keyin — **be**, have / has / had dan keyin — **been**, is / was (davomli zamon), predlog yoki -ing talab qiladigan fe'ldan keyin — **being**. V3 esa hamma joyda bir xil qoladi. Davomli va perfekt shakllar qizil kitobda qisqa o'tilgan (→ qizil kitob, 22-dars).

rows: to (want to, need to, have to)
It **has been done**. It **had been done**.
I hate **being told** what to do.

blocks.text: Modal fe'ldan keyin fe'l doim asosiy shaklda keladi, majhul nisbatda bu asosiy shakl — **be**: can **be** done, must **be** done, will **be** done, should **be** done, might **be** done. O'zbekchada bunga «-ilishi kerak», «-ilishi mumkin», «-ib bo'lmaydi» to'g'ri keladi: The form **must be signed** — Shakl **imzolanishi shart**. **be going to** va **have to** ham shunday ishlaydi: It**'s going to be built**, It **has to be finished**.

items.text: This form **must be completed** in black ink.
The new airport **will be opened** by the president next month.
Some mistakes **can't be corrected** once the document is printed.
items.translation: Hujjat chop etilgach, ba'zi xatolarni **tuzatib bo'lmaydi**.

blocks.text: to be + V3: infinitiv kerak bo'lgan joyda

want, hope, expect, need, would like, refuse kabi fe'llardan keyin infinitiv keladi. Agar harakatni ega o'zi bajarsa — **to do**, agar harakat egaga nisbatan bajarilsa — **to be done**. Solishtiring: Aziz wants **to interview** the minister (o'zi intervyu oladi) — The minister doesn't want **to be interviewed** (undan intervyu olishlarini xohlamaydi). «There's a lot **to be done**» — «Qilinishi kerak bo'lgan ishlar ko'p» iborasi ham shu qolipda.

items.text: Every child wants **to be loved** and **to be listened to**.
The old documents need **to be scanned** before we move office.
items.translation: Ofisni ko'chirishdan oldin eski hujjatlar **skanerlanishi kerak**.

items.text: Bekzod expected **to be paid** on Friday, but the money didn't come.
items.translation: Bekzod juma kuni **maosh olishni** kutgan edi, lekin pul kelmadi.

blocks.text: has been done, had been done: natija va oldinroq bo'lgan voqea

Present Perfect majhuli — **has / have been + V3**: natija hozir ko'rinib turibdi (The road **has been closed** — yo'l yopilgan, hozir yopiq). Past Perfect majhuli — **had been + V3**: o'tmishdagi boshqa voqeadan **oldin** bajarilgan harakat (→ 15-dars): When I arrived, the food **had been eaten** — men kelganimda ovqat yeb bo'lingan edi. Bu shakllarning ma'nosi faol nisbatdagidek (→ 7–8, 15-darslar), faqat ega harakatni qabul qiladi.

items.text: Our street **has been renamed** after a famous poet.
When we got to the cinema, the film **had been cancelled**.
items.translation: Kinoteatrga yetib borganimizda, film **bekor qilingan edi**.

items.text: **Have** the new rules **been explained** to everyone?

blocks.text: is being done, was being done: jarayondagi majhul

Davomli majhul — **is / are being + V3** (hozir jarayonda) va **was / were being + V3** (o'tmishdagi ma'lum paytda jarayonda). Bu o'zbekchadagi «ta'mirla**n**yapti», «ta'mirla**n**ayotgan edi» ning aynan o'zi. Eng ko'p xato shu yerda: «Yo'l ta'mirlanyapti» ni «The road is repairing» deb tarjima qilish — bu «yo'l nimanidir ta'mirlayapti» degani bo'lib qoladi. To'g'risi: The road **is being repaired**.

rows: The road **was being repaired** in May.
The road **had been repaired** before winter.
The road **will be repaired** next year.

blocks.text: enjoy, hate, like, mind, avoid, remember, can't stand kabi fe'llardan keyin va har qanday **predlogdan** keyin (without, after, before, instead of, about, of) -ing shakli keladi. Majhul ma'noda bu — **being + V3**: I don't like **being photographed** — Meni **suratga olishlarini** yoqtirmayman. O'zbekchada bu ko'pincha «-ishlarini», «-ilishni», «-masdan» bilan beriladi. Gap boshida ham kelishi mumkin: **Being invited** to the final was a surprise.

items.text: She left the room without **being seen**.
items.translation: U hech kimga **ko'rinmasdan** xonadan chiqib ketdi.

items.text: Most people hate **being kept** waiting on the phone.
items.translation: Ko'pchilik telefonda uzoq **kuttirib qo'yilishni** yomon ko'radi.

items.text: After **being checked** by the doctor, the boy was sent home.

blocks.text: should have been done: o'tmish haqida modal fikr

Modal fe'l + **have been + V3** — o'tmish haqida taxmin, afsus yoki tanqid: **should have been done** — qilinishi kerak edi (lekin qilinmadi), **could have been done** — qilish mumkin edi, **must have been done** — qilingan bo'lsa kerak, **can't have been done** — qilingan bo'lishi mumkin emas, **might have been done** — qilingan bo'lishi mumkin. Faol shakllarining ma'nosi oldin o'tilgan (→ 27–29, 33-darslar).

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «The road is repairing now» → The road **is being repaired** (o'zbekcha «-n-» qo'shimchasi inglizchada **being** bilan beriladi); «It must done today» → It **must be done** (be tushib qolmasin); «The house has built» → The house **has been built** (been siz gap «uy nimanidir qurdi» degan ma'no beradi); «It should be finish» → **finished** (V3 shart); «I don't like when people interrupt me» o'rniga qisqaroq va tabiiyroq: I don't like **being interrupted**.
Bo'sh joydan oldingi so'zga qarang: **can / must / will / to** → **be**; **have / has / had** → **been**; **is / was**, predlog yoki **enjoy / hate / avoid** → **being**. Keyin V3 qo'ying — tamom.

rows: I want **to be told** the truth.
It **had been sold** before I came.

examples.title: **can / must / should be** + V3
examples.description: Modal fe'ldan keyin majhul nisbat — be + V3: imkon, majburiyat, maslahat. O'zbekchada «-ilishi kerak», «-ib bo'lmaydi».

sentences.text: This medicine **must be taken** with food, otherwise it can hurt your stomach.
sentences.translation: Bu dori ovqat bilan **ichilishi shart**, aks holda oshqozonga zarar berishi mumkin.

sentences.text: Mobile phones **should be switched off** before the exam begins.
sentences.translation: Imtihon boshlanishidan oldin mobil telefonlar **o'chirilishi kerak**.

sentences.text: **Can** this jacket **be washed** in a machine, or does it need dry cleaning?
sentences.translation: Bu kurtkani mashinada **yuvsa bo'ladimi** yoki kimyoviy tozalash kerakmi?

sentences.text: The problem **can't be solved** overnight, but we're doing our best.
sentences.translation: Muammoni bir kechada **hal qilib bo'lmaydi**, lekin qo'limizdan kelganini qilyapmiz.

sentences.text: Children under twelve **mustn't be left** alone in the swimming pool.
sentences.translation: O'n ikki yoshgacha bolalarni basseynda yolg'iz **qoldirish mumkin emas**.

sentences.text: Tickets **may be bought** online or at the box office on the day of the concert.
sentences.translation: Chiptalarni onlayn yoki konsert kuni kassadan **sotib olish mumkin**.

sentences.text: Your password **should be changed** every few months to keep your account safe.
sentences.translation: Akkauntingiz xavfsiz bo'lishi uchun parolingiz har bir necha oyda **o'zgartirilishi kerak**.

sentences.text: In my opinion, cars **shouldn't be allowed** in the old city of Bukhara.
sentences.translation: Menimcha, Buxoroning eski shahrida mashinalarga **ruxsat berilmasligi kerak**.

sentences.text: Do you think the old factory **could be turned** into a modern art gallery?
sentences.translation: Sizningcha, eski zavodni zamonaviy san'at galereyasiga **aylantirish mumkinmi**?

sentences.text: If the form isn't signed, it **can't be processed**, so please check every page.
sentences.translation: Shakl imzolanmagan bo'lsa, uni **ko'rib chiqib bo'lmaydi**, shuning uchun har bir sahifani tekshiring.

examples.title: **will be** / **is going to be** + V3: the future
examples.description: Kelajakdagi majhul: will be + V3 va be going to be + V3. Rasmiy e'lon va rejalar uchun juda ko'p ishlatiladi.

sentences.text: The results **will be announced** on the university website next Friday.
sentences.translation: Natijalar kelasi juma kuni universitet saytida **e'lon qilinadi**.

sentences.text: A new bridge **is going to be built** across the river near Chirchiq.
sentences.translation: Chirchiq yaqinida daryo ustidan yangi ko'prik **quriladigan bo'ldi**.

sentences.text: Don't worry, you **won't be charged** for delivery if you order before Sunday.
sentences.translation: Xavotir olmang, yakshanbagacha buyurtma bersangiz, yetkazib berish uchun sizdan **pul olinmaydi**.

sentences.text: **Will** the meeting **be recorded**, or should I take notes?
sentences.translation: Yig'ilish **yozib olinadimi** yoki men qayd qilib boraymi?

sentences.text: All the old computers **are going to be replaced** by laptops this summer.
sentences.translation: Bu yoz barcha eski kompyuterlar noutbuklarga **almashtiriladi**.

sentences.text: Your order **will be delivered** within three working days.
sentences.translation: Buyurtmangiz uch ish kuni ichida **yetkazib beriladi**.

sentences.text: **Is** tonight's match **going to be shown** on TV, or only online?
sentences.translation: Bugungi o'yin televizorda **ko'rsatiladimi** yoki faqat internetdami?

sentences.text: From next year, all students **will be required** to wear a uniform.
sentences.translation: Kelasi yildan boshlab barcha talabalardan forma kiyish **talab qilinadi**.

sentences.text: Aziz is nervous because he**'s going to be interviewed** by three managers.
sentences.translation: Aziz hayajonda, chunki uni uchta menejer **suhbatdan o'tkazadi**.

sentences.text: When the new line opens, the journey to the airport **will be cut** to twenty minutes.
sentences.translation: Yangi liniya ochilganda, aeroportgacha bo'lgan yo'l yigirma daqiqagacha **qisqaradi**.

examples.title: **to be** + V3: want to be, need to be, hope to be
examples.description: Infinitiv kerak bo'lgan joyda majhul: to be + V3. Harakatni ega o'zi emas, boshqalar bajaradi.

sentences.text: Nobody likes **to be ignored**, especially by their own colleagues.
sentences.translation: Hech kim **e'tiborsiz qolishni** yoqtirmaydi, ayniqsa o'z hamkasblari tomonidan.

sentences.text: Madina hopes **to be chosen** for the national volleyball team this year.
sentences.translation: Madina bu yil voleybol bo'yicha terma jamoaga **tanlanishga** umid qilyapti.

sentences.text: There's still a lot of work **to be done** before the hotel can open.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxona ochilishidan oldin hali ko'p ish **qilinishi kerak**.

sentences.text: My grandfather didn't want **to be taken** to hospital, so the doctor came to the house.
sentences.translation: Bobom kasalxonaga **olib borilishni** xohlamadi, shuning uchun shifokor uyga keldi.

sentences.text: The contract **needs to be translated** into English before Friday.
sentences.translation: Shartnoma jumagacha ingliz tiliga **tarjima qilinishi kerak**.

sentences.text: Every patient has the right **to be treated** with respect, whatever their background.
sentences.translation: Kelib chiqishidan qat'i nazar, har bir bemor hurmat bilan **davolanish** huquqiga ega.

sentences.text: James expects **to be promoted** after the success of his last project.
sentences.translation: So'nggi loyihasi muvaffaqiyatli o'tgach, Jeyms **lavozimi ko'tarilishini** kutyapti.

sentences.text: Do you want **to be woken up** early tomorrow, or can you sleep in?
sentences.translation: Ertaga sizni erta **uyg'otishlarini** xohlaysizmi yoki bemalol uxlaysizmi?

sentences.text: Old batteries **have to be recycled**, not thrown in the ordinary bin.
sentences.translation: Eski batareyalar oddiy axlat qutisiga tashlanmasdan, **qayta ishlanishi kerak**.

sentences.text: Kate wanted to interview the minister, but he refused **to be interviewed**.
sentences.translation: Keyt vazirdan intervyu olmoqchi edi, lekin u **intervyu berishdan** bosh tortdi.

examples.title: **has been** + V3 and **had been** + V3
examples.description: Perfekt majhul: has / have been + V3 — natija hozir; had been + V3 — o'tmishdagi boshqa voqeadan oldin bajarilgan.

sentences.text: Your flight **has been cancelled**, but you can take the next one at six.
sentences.translation: Reysingiz **bekor qilindi**, lekin soat oltidagisiga chiqishingiz mumkin.

sentences.text: Several new cafés **have been opened** near the university this year.
sentences.translation: Bu yil universitet yaqinida bir nechta yangi kafe **ochildi**.

sentences.text: **Has** the problem with the heating **been fixed**? It's freezing in here.
sentences.translation: Isitishdagi nosozlik **tuzatildimi**? Bu yer muzlab ketgan-ku.

sentences.text: Bekzod **has been chosen** to represent our school at the competition in Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Bekzod Toshkentdagi musobaqada maktabimiz nomidan qatnashish uchun **tanlandi**.

sentences.text: Hundreds of photos **have been posted** online since the festival started.
sentences.translation: Festival boshlanganidan beri internetga yuzlab suratlar **joylandi**.

sentences.text: When we got to the stadium, all the tickets **had** already **been sold**.
sentences.translation: Stadionga yetib borganimizda, barcha chiptalar allaqachon **sotib bo'lingan edi**.

sentences.text: Emma didn't recognise her old school because it **had been painted** bright yellow.
sentences.translation: Emma eski maktabini tanimadi, chunki u och sariq rangga **bo'yalgan edi**.

sentences.text: Nothing **has been decided** yet — we're still discussing the options.
sentences.translation: Hali hech narsa **hal qilinmagan** — variantlarni muhokama qilyapmiz.

sentences.text: I couldn't pay for dinner because my card **had been blocked** by the bank.
sentences.translation: Kechki ovqat uchun to'lay olmadim, chunki bank kartamni **bloklab qo'ygan edi**.

sentences.text: Since the speed cameras were installed, fewer accidents **have been reported** on this road.
sentences.translation: Tezlik kameralari o'rnatilganidan beri bu yo'lda kamroq avariya **qayd etildi**.

examples.title: **is being** + V3 and **was being** + V3: in progress
examples.description: Davomli majhul: harakat hozir yoki o'tmishning ma'lum paytida jarayonda. O'zbekchada «-ilyapti», «-ilayotgan edi».

sentences.text: Sorry for the noise — the flat next door **is being renovated**.
sentences.translation: Shovqin uchun uzr — qo'shni kvartira **ta'mirlanyapti**.

sentences.text: The main road **is being resurfaced**, so the buses are taking a different route.
sentences.translation: Asosiy yo'lga yangi asfalt **yotqizilyapti**, shuning uchun avtobuslar boshqa yo'ldan yuryapti.

sentences.text: **Is** the conference **being filmed**? I'd like to watch it again later.
sentences.translation: Konferensiya **suratga olinyaptimi**? Keyinroq yana bir bor ko'rmoqchi edim.

sentences.text: Hold on, please, your call **is being transferred** to the sales department.
sentences.translation: Iltimos, kutib turing, qo'ng'irog'ingiz savdo bo'limiga **ulanmoqda**.

sentences.text: I had a feeling that I **was being followed**, so I went into a shop.
sentences.translation: Meni kimdir **kuzatib kelayotgandek** tuyuldi, shuning uchun bir do'konga kirib oldim.

sentences.text: When I arrived at the office, the new staff **were being shown** around the building.
sentences.translation: Ofisga kelganimda, yangi xodimlarni bino bo'ylab **aylantirishayotgan edi**.

sentences.text: At the moment, a new booking system **is being tested** in three hospitals in Samarkand.
sentences.translation: Hozir Samarqanddagi uchta shifoxonada yangi navbat tizimi **sinovdan o'tkazilyapti**.

sentences.text: Our kitchen **was being painted**, so we ate at my parents' house all week.
sentences.translation: Oshxonamiz **bo'yalayotgan edi**, shuning uchun butun hafta ota-onamnikida ovqatlandik.

sentences.text: Hotel rooms **are cleaned** every day, but this one **is being cleaned** right now.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxona xonalari har kuni **tozalanadi**, bu xona esa ayni paytda **tozalanyapti**.

sentences.text: Why **are** so many old trees **being cut down** in the city centre?
sentences.translation: Nega shahar markazida shuncha keksa daraxt **kesilyapti**?

examples.title: **being** + V3: hate being told, without being seen
examples.description: -ing shakli kerak bo'lgan joyda (enjoy, hate, avoid, mind fe'llaridan va predlogdan keyin) majhul — being + V3.

sentences.text: I hate **being interrupted** when I'm explaining something important.
sentences.translation: Muhim narsani tushuntirayotganimda **gapimni bo'lishlarini** yomon ko'raman.

sentences.text: Teenagers usually can't stand **being told** what to wear.
sentences.translation: O'smirlar odatda nima kiyish kerakligini **aytishlariga** chiday olmaydi.

sentences.text: Jasur managed to leave the party without **being noticed** by anyone.
sentences.translation: Jasur ziyofatdan hech kimga **sezdirmasdan** chiqib ketishga ulgurdi.

sentences.text: After **being stopped** by the police twice, Tom finally fixed his headlight.
sentences.translation: Politsiya ikki marta **to'xtatgandan** keyin, Tom nihoyat farasini tuzatdi.

sentences.text: Do you mind **being photographed**? It's for the school magazine.
sentences.translation: **Suratga tushishga** qarshi emasmisiz? Maktab jurnali uchun.

sentences.text: Dilnoza still remembers **being taken** to Khiva by her grandfather when she was six.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza olti yoshligida bobosi uni Xivaga **olib borganini** hali ham eslaydi.

sentences.text: Most celebrities are tired of **being followed** by photographers wherever they go.
sentences.translation: Ko'p mashhur odamlar qayerga bormasin, fotograflar **ortidan yurishidan** charchagan.

sentences.text: Instead of **being thanked** for her hard work, Kate was blamed for the delay.
sentences.translation: Keytga mehnati uchun **rahmat aytish** o'rniga, uni kechikishda ayblashdi.

sentences.text: My little brother is scared of **being left** alone at home at night.
sentences.translation: Ukam kechasi uyda yolg'iz **qolib ketishdan** qo'rqadi.

sentences.text: **Being chosen** as team captain was the proudest moment of Oliver's life.
sentences.translation: Jamoa sardori etib **saylanish** Oliverning hayotidagi eng faxrli lahza bo'ldi.

examples.title: **should have been** / **must have been** + V3
examples.description: Modal + have been + V3 — o'tmish haqida majhul fikr: tanqid (should), imkon (could), taxmin (must, might, can't).

sentences.text: The accident **could have been avoided** if the driver had slowed down.
sentences.translation: Haydovchi tezlikni pasaytirganida, avariyaning **oldini olish mumkin edi**.

sentences.text: These letters **should have been sent** last week — why are they still on your desk?
sentences.translation: Bu xatlar o'tgan hafta **yuborilishi kerak edi** — nega hali ham stolingizda turibdi?

sentences.text: The window was open when we came back, so it **must have been left** open by the cleaner.
sentences.translation: Qaytib kelganimizda deraza ochiq edi, demak, uni farrosh ochiq **qoldirgan bo'lsa kerak**.

sentences.text: I'm not sure who took the money, but it **might have been taken** by someone from outside.
sentences.translation: Pulni kim olganini bilmayman, lekin uni tashqaridan kimdir **olgan bo'lishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: Madina's bag **must have been stolen** while she was paying at the till.
sentences.translation: Madinaning sumkasi kassada pul to'layotganida **o'g'irlangan bo'lsa kerak**.

sentences.text: In my view, the old teacher **shouldn't have been dismissed** after thirty years of work.
sentences.translation: Menimcha, keksa o'qituvchini o'ttiz yillik mehnatidan keyin **ishdan bo'shatmaslik kerak edi**.

sentences.text: Look at this cake! It **can't have been made** by a child — it's too perfect.
sentences.translation: Bu tortga qarang! Uni bola **tayyorlagan bo'lishi mumkin emas** — juda mukammal.

sentences.text: With better planning, the project **could have been finished** in half the time.
sentences.translation: Yaxshiroq rejalashtirilganda, loyihani ikki baravar tezroq **tugatish mumkin edi**.

sentences.text: Why didn't anyone call me? I **should have been told** about the change too.
sentences.translation: Nega hech kim menga qo'ng'iroq qilmadi? O'zgarish haqida menga ham **aytilishi kerak edi**.

sentences.text: Everything is wet, so the garden **must have been watered** this morning.
sentences.translation: Hamma yoq ho'l, demak, bog' bugun ertalab **sug'orilgan bo'lsa kerak**.

examples.title: Mixed: **be**, **been** or **being**?
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: bitta gapda bir nechta majhul shakl — oldingi so'zga qarab be, been yoki being tanlanadi.

sentences.text: The new hospital **is being built** now and **will be opened** next spring.
sentences.translation: Yangi shifoxona hozir **qurilyapti** va kelasi bahorda **ochiladi**.

sentences.text: Your essay **has been checked**, but some parts **need to be rewritten**.
sentences.translation: Inshoingiz **tekshirildi**, lekin ba'zi qismlarini **qayta yozish kerak**.

sentences.text: Nilufar was worried about **being recognised**, so she wore dark glasses.
sentences.translation: Nilufar **tanib qolishlaridan** xavotirda edi, shuning uchun qora ko'zoynak taqdi.

sentences.text: **Has** your visa **been approved**, or **is** it still **being processed**?
sentences.translation: Vizangiz **tasdiqlandimi** yoki hali **ko'rib chiqilyaptimi**?

sentences.text: By the time the firefighters arrived, most of the building **had been destroyed**.
sentences.translation: O't o'chiruvchilar yetib kelganda, binoning katta qismi **vayron bo'lgan edi**.

sentences.text: These seats **can't be reserved** — they're for people who arrive first.
sentences.translation: Bu o'rinlarni **band qilib bo'lmaydi** — ular birinchi kelganlar uchun.

sentences.text: Something **must be done** about the traffic before the city stops moving completely.
sentences.translation: Shahar butunlay tiqilib qolmasidan oldin tirbandlik bo'yicha nimadir **qilinishi kerak**.

sentences.text: While the bridge **was being repaired**, we had to drive an extra twenty kilometres.
sentences.translation: Ko'prik **ta'mirlanayotgan paytda** qo'shimcha yigirma kilometr yo'l yurishga majbur bo'ldik.

sentences.text: James was really upset about **not being invited** to his best friend's wedding.
sentences.translation: Jeyms eng yaqin do'stining to'yiga **taklif qilinmaganidan** qattiq xafa bo'ldi.

sentences.text: The museum was closed for two years, but it **has** just **been reopened** to the public.
sentences.translation: Muzey ikki yil yopiq turdi, lekin yaqinda tashrifchilar uchun qayta **ochildi**.
